roads.name: South Entrance Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 17 curves in 3.5 miles.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 7,502 to 7,758 ft, with 676 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 73°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 25 mph limit its corners ask for only about 0.08 g, so the limit, not the curves, sets the pace.
